verdict.rationale: Reducto documents a presigned-URL upload path for files up to 5GB, an async job endpoint that returns a job ID immediately, configurable timeouts in parse settings, and "No Page Limits" on its plans. Those cover the multi-gigabyte and timeout parts of the story. Nothing documents reliable handling of thousand-page documents or any guard against silent truncation, and one user reported Reducto "did struggle with long documents" at 300+ pages, which is too vague to dispute the claims but lowers confidence. Missing for 10: explicit thousand-page processing guarantees or benchmarks, truncation detection or completeness guarantees, independent hands-on corroboration of large-file reliability.

support.subject: As a data engineer, thousand-page documents and multi-gigabyte files process reliably without timeouts or silent truncation

citations.quote: Files over 100MB? Use the presigned URL method which supports files up to 5GB.
The `settings` config group controls how documents are processed, including timeouts
